headline: Open a meeting that has ended to wrap it up: keep or ignore its promises, star them into Focus, and choose who gets a follow-up email. Choices made on a meeting's own page now decide its follow-up, and a choice that cannot be matched to the meeting waits instead of guessing. The prep answer box no longer saves an answer that names someone off limits. After updating, say "update my hub" once and reload the Hub tab.
